name: Porcupine
summary: Porcupine is a Mang Den delicacy of lean meat, served grilled, stuffed into bamboo shoots, cooked in a soup, or wrapped in dong leaves.
howToEat: Choose from four preparations: grilled, stuffed into bamboo shoots, in a soup, or packed in dong leaves.
